saludo: We make custom websites, end to end, and leave them ready to be changed with AI.

expl: End-to-end: from the idea to the published website.
Collaboration: we join your team on whatever it needs.
Consulting: we help you and train your team to change your website with AI.
servicio.q: How would you like to work with us?

opciones.r: From the first conversation to the published website. Let's get to know your project.
We join your team on the part that needs it most.
We help you decide and organise your website so you can change it with AI.
No problem. Tell us and we'll say which one fits.

solo.r: Of course. Write it below and we'll answer.

opciones.r: If it locks you in, we migrate it as it is, pixel for pixel, with its CMS.
That can be migrated too. We'll look at it with you.
Even better: we start from scratch.

marca.q: Do you have a defined brand? Logo, typography, colours…

opciones.r: We start from it.
We'll organise it together in your savvia.
To start we need at least a logo and a visual idea. We'll talk it through on the call.

tamano.q: Roughly how many pages do you need?

opciones.r: Little and well made.
A very manageable size.
Perfect.
Then your website's savvia will be key.

extras.q: What else do you need? You can pick several.

parte.q: Which part would you like us to join? You can pick several.

equipo.q: Who would we be working with?

opciones.r: Better that way: they keep the knowledge.
We'll coordinate without any problem.
We adapt to the way you work.
Then we'll make everything very clear for you.

quiere.q: What would you like to decide or organise? You can pick several.

cambia.q: How do you change your website today?

opciones.r: A lot of time gets lost there.
Perfect, so there's a base.
Very common, and fixable.
That's exactly what a savvia is for.

frase.q: Tell us in one sentence what you need.
frase.r: Thanks, that's enough for us to point you in the right direction.

plazo.q: When would you need it by?

opciones.r: That's short to do it with care, but tell us and we'll see.
A good timeframe.
Perfect, so we can prepare it calmly.

contacto.q: Which email should we write to?
Anything else you'd like to tell us? Your company, your current website, a rough budget…

fin: Thanks, {nombre}. With this we'll arrive at the call with context.
We'll write to you within 48 hours.
